source.place: Tag 0D62, proof split into existence and uniqueness

proof.text: Let T_n be the standard truncation at -n and let a : E → ∏ T_n be the product of the canonical maps. The identity π_natTransTruncGEOfLE_app makes these maps compatible with the transition maps. Product extensionality and the definition of 1-s give a ≫ (1-s) = 0.
The specified derived-limit triangle is distinguished. Apply Mathlib Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ to a and its zero composite to obtain c : E → K with a = c ≫ π.

Compose a = c ≫ π with each product projection and use Pi.lift_π. This gives every required compatibility equation. No pointwise cohomology bound is needed for existence; those bounds belong to the isomorphism argument.

title: Existence in the pointwise truncation limit argument
statement: The hypotheses and data of lem-pc-ringed-space-pointwise-truncation-limit imply existence of a compatible morphism c : E ⟶ K.

lean.statement: theorem pointwise_truncation_limit_exists (X : RingedSpace.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))] (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ (b : ℤ → ℤ) (B : Set (Opens X)), (∀ U ∈ B, x ∈ U) ∧ (∀ V : Opens X, x ∈ V → ∃ U ∈ B, U ≤ V) ∧ (∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (U : Opens X), U ∈ B → b m < (p : ℤ) → IsZero ((openModuleCohomology X p U).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))) [HasProduct (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)] (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (π : K ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)) (δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hK : IsDerivedLimitTriangle (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.natTransTruncGEOfLE (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E) K π δ) : (∃ c : E ⟶ K, ∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ π ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E) n = (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E)
